title: GRAFFITI BRUSHES #2
author: Dansdesign
description:
We’ve been working with graffiti for a long time and recently we’ve noticed a demand on specific materials for people who would like to work with graffiti digitally. As a graffiti artist who focuses almost exclusively in analog artwork, We’ve spent hours of time dedicated to creating handmade resources analog style to work digitally in Procreate using the iPad Pro and Apple Pencil. And we have studied what works and what does not to create our own extensive brush sets. We designed sets of brushes complete with drips, splashes and some templates of graffiti tools, allows you to have a perfect possibility of creation. 
Dans Graffiti brush procreate 1 will make it easier for you to be creative in making digital works with analog touches that look very real, you can use it to make lettering designs, posters, flyers, or design anything without any limitations as you wish
Dans Graffiti brush procreate #2 includes 5 amazing graffiti brush.
